en: We’re sorry for the trouble. Successful payments usually confirm in real time. If payment failed but money was debited, it often reverses automatically — contact your bank if not reversed in the usual time. Check status: https://lifeguru.app/profile — or say “human agent” with registered mobile.
hi: Asuvidha ke liye maafi. Payment success par booking real time confirm hoti hai. Fail par debit ho to aksar auto-reverse hota hai — nahi ho to bank se poochhein. Status: https://lifeguru.app/profile — ya registered mobile ke saath “human agent”.

en: This can happen due to a brief technical issue. Please check booking history: https://lifeguru.app/profile — if nothing appears, say “human agent” with your payment time and registered mobile 🙏
hi: Kabhi technical issue se confirmation delay ho sakta hai. https://lifeguru.app/profile par dekhein — na mile to payment time + mobile ke saath “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: Names allowed depend on package: Single — 1; Couple — up to 2; Family — up to 6. To add beyond the limit, book the same puja again with a suitable package. To update names while the window is open, say “human agent” 🙏
hi: Package ke hisaab se naam: Single — 1; Couple — 2; Family — 6 tak. Zyada naam ke liye dubara book karein. Window khuli ho to update ke liye “human agent” likhein 🙏

en: You can update devotee name, gotra, wishes, or WhatsApp number before the booking window closes. Share exact updates — if the window is open, say “human agent” and we will confirm after changing.
hi: Booking window band hone se pehle naam, gotra, manokamna ya WhatsApp update ho sakte hain. Sahi details bhejein — “human agent” likhein agar window khuli ho.

en: Namaste 🙏 LifeGuru complies with applicable laws; GST on puja-related services is mandatory as per government norms. Thank you for your understanding 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Sarkari norms ke mutabik puja services par GST lagta hai — yeh mandatory hai. Dhanyawad 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 To help quickly, please share puja name, puja date, and registered mobile number (or Order ID from the app).
hi: Namaste 🙏 Jaldi madad ke liye puja ka naam, date aur registered mobile (ya Order ID) bhejein.

en: If gotra is not known, tradition often uses Kashyap Gotra for the sankalp. You may enter that at booking or tell the team when updating details 🙏
hi: Agar gotra nahi pata ho to sankalp ke liye aksar Kashyap Gotra use hota hai — booking par ya team ko batayein 🙏

en: Name and gotra can be updated only before the booking window closes. Share the correct name and gotra — say “human agent” and we will update if the window is still open.
hi: Naam/gotra sirf booking window band hone se pehle update ho sakte hain. Sahi naam-gotra bhejein — “human agent” likhein, window khuli ho to update karenge.

en: We are reviewing your details. Please give us a moment — we will get back to you shortly 🙏
hi: Aapki details review ho rahi hain. Thoda samay dein — jald jawab denge 🙏

en: Sorry for the confusion — a “failed” message sometimes appears on a duplicate booking attempt when the same seva was booked twice; your first booking may still be confirmed. Check https://lifeguru.app/profile or say “human agent” with registered mobile.
hi: Kabhi same seva dubara book karne par “failed” message aata hai jabki pehli booking confirm ho — profile check karein: https://lifeguru.app/profile ya “human agent”.
